canonical_project: Green Power Park Lobstädt / Neukieritzsch data center
owner: PV Backoffice GmbH / Green Power Park Lobstädt GmbH i.G.
notes: Project proposes a combination of data center, green hydrogen production, and battery storage on a former briquette-factory site in Lobstädt/Neukieritzsch; citizen initiatives failed to block the project because the required quorum was not reached.
